newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Candelaria copper mine strike over.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Candelaria copper mine strike over.

text.p: A strike at Phelps Dodge Candelaria copper mine in northern Chile has ended and the pit is working normally, said a spokesman for the mine Monday.
"Everything is normal. Production always was normal (during the strike)," the spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesmen said that the around 200 striking miners ended a six-day strike Sunday after agreeing to accept management's final pay offer which they had originally rejected.
Production at the 150,000-tonne a year pit was hardly affected by the walkout, he said.
Only one third of the pit's labour force was on strike and the company was able to keep up output by using stocks and reorganizing shifts of non-striking employees.
The spokesman said the miners have signed a five year labour deal.
This contract ends the current round of collective negotiations with Candelaria's employees in Chile, he added.
The strike was the third to hit Chile's all-important copper mining industry this year and follows walkouts in state giant Codelco's Chuquicamata and Salvador pits.
